# Fitbit MCP
Unofficial local-first Fitbit MCP server for AI activity, heart rate, sleep, HRV, SpO2 and body composition agents.
Repository: https://github.com/davidmosiah/fitbitmcp
Homepage: https://wellness.delx.ai/connectors/fitbit
NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/fitbit-mcp-unofficial
Primary command: npm exec --yes --package=fitbit-mcp-unofficial -- fitbit-mcp-server doctor
MCP command: fitbit-mcp-server

- MCP registry name: io.github.davidmosiah/fitbitmcp
- Start agents with fitbit_connection_status and fitbit_data_inventory before any data tool.
- Read-only default tools: fitbit_agent_manifest, fitbit_capabilities, fitbit_privacy_audit, fitbit_connection_status, fitbit_data_inventory, fitbit_daily_summary, fitbit_weekly_summary, fitbit_cache_status.
- OAuth env: FITBIT_CLIENT_ID, FITBIT_CLIENT_SECRET, FITBIT_REDIRECT_URI.
- Optional env: FITBIT_TOKEN_PATH (token storage path), FITBIT_PRIVACY_MODE (summary|structured|raw, default structured), FITBIT_CACHE (true|sqlite to enable), FITBIT_CACHE_PATH.
- Note: Google Health API v4 migration is underway — see google-health-mcp for the successor pathway.
- Prefer JSON responses for automation and markdown responses for human summaries.
- Tokens stay local under ~/.fitbitmcp/tokens.json (or equivalent) and should never be printed.
- Not medical advice. Use as trend context only — outputs are operational context, not medical, legal or financial advice.
